t: This compact Triton T30I Instaflow electric water heater provides instant hot water in locations with only a cold mains supply. Ideal for cloakrooms, toilets, utility rooms, or commercial settings such as workshops and garages. The unit features a single control for easy start, stop, and temperature selection, while the specially designed nozzle prevents splash-back during handwashing. For enhanced safety, it includes overheat cut-out protection. This wall-mounted solution offers a practical and space-saving method for generating hot water where needed.
b: Suitable for Cold Mains Supply Only
